question: Husk of a coconut is made of ______ tissue.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sclerenchyma.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Sclerenchyma tissues** make up the **coconut husk.**
 
• It is merely an** everlasting tissue.**
 
• **Long and tapering** at the ends, cells contain a** thick lignin-based cell wall.**
 
• These cells** lack protoplasm** and are typically **dead.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Collenchyma:**

 
 
• Several **herbaceous and woody plants** have collenchyma, which is a supporting tissue unique to the **developing organs **of those plants.
 
• Mature herbaceous plants' **stems and leaves** also contain it.
 
 
 
• **Xylem:**
 
 
• The **specialized tissu**e in vascular plants called xylem distributes **nutrients and water** from the **plant-soil contact **to the stems and leaves.
 
• They also give the plants **mechanical strength.**
 
 
 
• **Parenchyma:**
 
 
• It is a basic **permanent tissue.**
 
• **It** makes up a** large portion of the ground tissues of plants**, where vascular tissues and other tissues are attached.
